_doc: Runtime switches. data: the scene.json to load, relative to game/ (round-20 stand-in: assets_stub/r20/data/scene.json; Blender export: data/scene.json). sounds: the sounds.json (stand-in: assets_stub/r20/data/sounds.json; audio pass: data/sounds.json). start: the location a new game begins in; its scene.json is data, every other location <name> is read from locations/<name>/data/scene.json. audio: rain and fire are the loops of the open yard; an interior (scene.json "rain": false) plays the fire loop of its own light group (fire_group lists one id per location) and the room tone `room`, a loop that is made in code while the file is missing. archetypes: the builds a new game offers (data/archetypes.json). location_names: what the save lists call a location. Override data on the command line with: Godot --path game -- --data=data/scene.json
